description: This file defines the 'ArraySerializer' class within the Laminas\Diactoros" namespace. The class provides methods to serialize HTTP request objects into arrays and deserialize arrays back into request objects, including handling exceptions during deserialization.

classes.name: ArraySerializer
classes.description: Provides static methods for serializing and deserializing HTTP request messages to and from arrays.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes a RequestInterface object into an associative array with request details.

methods.name: fromArray
methods.description: Deserializes an array into a Request object, reconstructing the request message.

methods.name: getValueFromKey
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the array by key, throwing an exception if the key is missing.
